privileged_info_for_vlm: The project is a 4,200 sq ft medical office build-out. The final estimate should fall within the range of $350,000 to $800,000 based on a reference cost of approximately $236.56 per sq ft for full construction, adjusted for a tenant improvement (TI) factor. Expected divisions include concrete, metal, wood, millwork, doors, finishes, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire protection, and flooring. The agent must use the specific pricing found in material_prices.csv and labor_rates.csv.
